facts.label: official
facts.quote: As announced in the bi-monthly Monetary Policy Statement, 2026-27, today, it has been decided by the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) to increase the policy repo rate under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) by 25 basis points from 5.25 per cent to 5.50 per cent with immediate effect.
facts.text: The Reserve Bank of India increased the policy repo rate under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility by 25 basis points to 5.50 percent in October 2026.

youtube.description: 50 lakh ka ghar, par 20 saal ki EMI mein bank ko lagbhag dugna kyun jaata hai? Is video mein ek family ki loan file khol kar dekhte hain ki shuruaati EMI ka bada hissa byaaj mein kyun jaata hai, aur repo rate 5.50 percent hone pe EMI same rakhne se tenure chupchaap kaise badhti hai. Saath mein samjhiye ki saal mein ek extra EMI se loan kai saal pehle kaise khatam hota hai. Share karo us dost ko jo abhi naya flat lene ke liye home loan ki file sign karne wala hai.

script.hook: 50 lakh ka ghar lete ho, par bank ko lagbhag dugna kyun lautate ho?

scenes.label: 50 lakh ka ghar, bill dugna?

visual.prompt: Night, small living room of a new flat with unpacked cartons. WIFE and her husband, a young salaried man in a formal shirt, sit on the floor with a thick loan file open, a table lamp glowing, both frozen on one page, worried faces.

scenes.vo: 50 lakh ka ghar, aur bank ko jaane wala total paisa lagbhag dugna. Yeh mazaak nahi hai, yeh 20 saal ki EMI ka seedha hisaab hai. Raat ko Amit aur Pooja apni nayi loan file khol kar baithe hain, aur ek page pe nazar atak gayi hai.

visual.prompt: Close view of WIFE holding a long printed table of rows and columns, her finger tracing down the page, eyebrows rising, lamp light, night, no readable text.

scenes.vo: Us page ka naam hai amortisation schedule, yaani har mahine ki EMI ka poora breakup. Kitna paisa byaaj mein gaya, kitna loan mein. Pooja ne pehli line padhi, phir doosri, phir chup ho gayi. EMI bhari ja rahi thi, par loan mushkil se hil raha tha.

visual.prompt: SG in a striped shirt stands beside a large drawn house shape split into a small brick part and a big shadowed part, holding up his hand, calm explaining face, soft daylight.

scenes.vo: Aap bhi shayad isi file ke saath jee rahe ho, ya jeene wale ho. Isliye aaj teen sawaal. Pehla, ghar itna mehnga kyun padta hai? Doosra, rate badhne pe chupke se kya hota hai? Teesra, saal mein ek extra EMI kya kamaal karti hai?

scenes.label: EMI ke andar kya chhupa hai

visual.prompt: SG at a chapter turn, standing next to a drawn coin cut into two pieces, one labelled by colour as a small brick, the other as a bank building, pointing at it, friendly expression.

scenes.vo: Pehle ek seedhi baat. EMI yaani Equated Monthly Instalment, har mahine ki fixed kisht jo aap bank ko dete ho. Har EMI ke do hisse hote hain. Ek principal, yaani asli udhaar jo aapne liya. Doosra interest, yaani byaaj, bank ki kamaai udhaar dene ki.

visual.prompt: A drawn monthly salary envelope being poured into two jars, a huge jar shaped like a bank filling up fast and a tiny jar shaped like a house getting only a few drops, morning light.

scenes.vo: Ab trick yahan hai. Byaaj hamesha bache hue loan pe lagta hai. Shuru mein poora 50 lakh baaki hai, toh byaaj bhi sabse bada banta hai. EMI fixed hai, toh pehle byaaj katta hai, aur jo thoda bachta hai, wahi principal mein jaata hai.

visual.prompt: The husband, a young salaried man, smiling at his phone after an EMI payment, while behind him a thought bubble shows a house slowly filling with colour only at one tiny corner, evening.

scenes.vo: Amit ne socha tha, har mahine EMI bharunga, ghar dheere dheere mera hota jayega. Logic bilkul sahi lagta hai. Par schedule kuch aur keh raha tha. Shuruaati saalon mein EMI ka bada hissa sirf byaaj mein ja raha tha. Ownership ki speed bahut dheemi thi.

visual.prompt: A long road drawn uphill, a man pushing a heavy sack labelled by a bank symbol at the start, the sack shrinking far ahead near a sunny house at the end of the road.

scenes.vo: Isko kehte hain front-loaded interest, yaani byaaj ka bojh shuru mein bhaari, aur aakhir mein halka. Jaise jaise principal ghatta hai, byaaj bhi ghatta hai, aur EMI ka zyada hissa ghar ki taraf jaane lagta hai. Par yeh mod aane mein kai saal lag jaate hain.

visual.prompt: BANK UNCLE behind a bank counter hands a printed statement to WIFE and her husband, both leaning forward with shocked faces, fluorescent light, daytime bank branch.

scenes.vo: Pooja ne ek simple sawaal pucha. Agar hum kuch saal baad ghar bechna chahein, toh bank ko kitna dena padega? Bank Uncle ne statement nikaala. Jawab sun kar dono hairaan the. Itne saal EMI bharne ke baad bhi, baaki loan lagbhag wahin ka wahin tha.

visual.prompt: A family nameplate on a flat door, and a giant shadow of a bank building falling over the door, the husband standing at the door looking up uneasily, dusk.

scenes.vo: Yahi woh jhatka hai jo zyada log samajhte hi nahi. Unhe lagta hai EMI bhari, matlab ghar mein hissa badha. Par shuruaati saalon mein aap zyada tar bank ka kiraya bhar rahe ho. Ghar aapka kagaz pe hai, par paise ke hisaab se abhi bank ka hai.

visual.prompt: Two identical drawn houses side by side on a table, one bright and one made of stacked bank notes, WIFE looking from one to the other with her hand over her mouth, night.

scenes.vo: Ab total dekhiye. 20 saal tak har mahine EMI. Sab jodo toh jo ghar 50 lakh ka tha, uske liye aap bank ko lagbhag dugna lauta dete ho. Matlab jitna ghar ka daam, utna hi alag se byaaj. Bank ki kamaai yahi hai, aur yeh poori tarah legal hai.

visual.prompt: A stretched rubber band drawn as a calendar ribbon, getting longer and thinner, with a tiny coin on top and a huge pile of coins growing underneath, neutral background.

scenes.vo: Isme bank koi dhokha nahi kar raha. Lamba time, yaani lamba udhaar, yaani zyada byaaj. Jitni lambi tenure, yaani loan ki muddat, utni chhoti EMI lagti hai, par utna bada total bill banta hai. Chhoti EMI aankhon ko achhi lagti hai, jeb ko nahi.

visual.prompt: PAPA in a kurta sitting on a sofa with FD receipts on his lap, wagging a finger knowingly, the young couple listening respectfully, warm evening light.

scenes.vo: Papa ne yeh sun ke kaha, isliye hum toh kabhi loan nahi lete the, sab cash mein. Par aaj ke daam mein cash se ghar lena har kisi ke bas ki baat nahi. Toh sawaal loan lene ka nahi hai. Sawaal hai, loan ko samajh ke chalana.

scenes.label: Floating rate ka chupa jhatka

visual.prompt: SG at a chapter turn, holding a drawn balloon tied to a house, the balloon bobbing up and down, a big key hanging from the string, curious expression, daylight.

scenes.vo: Ab doosra sawaal, aur yeh sabse chupa hua hai. Amit aur Pooja ka loan floating rate pe hai. Floating rate yaani aisa byaaj jo fixed nahi, bazaar ke saath upar neeche hota hai. Aur iski chaabi ek jagah hai, RBI ka repo rate.

visual.prompt: A tall central bank building drawn at the top, a chain of strings running down to many small houses below, one string being pulled upward, a crowd of homeowners looking up, morning.

scenes.vo: Repo rate yaani woh byaaj jis pe RBI banks ko paisa deta hai. Jab yeh badhta hai, banks ka paisa mehnga hota hai, aur woh aapke loan ka rate bhi badha dete hain. Floating loan wale sab log is ek faisle se jude hote hain, chahe unhe pata ho ya nahi.

visual.prompt: A newspaper on a breakfast table next to a cup of chai, the husband reading it with mild interest, a tiny upward arrow drawn floating above the paper, morning light, no readable text.

scenes.vo: Is October RBI ne repo rate 25 basis points badha kar 5.50 percent kar diya. Basis point yaani percent ka sauwan hissa, toh 25 basis points matlab ek chauthai percent. Sunne mein chhota lagta hai. Par lambe home loan pe yeh chhota nahi rehta.

visual.prompt: The husband on a sofa looking at a phone notification with a relieved smile and a thumbs up, unaware of a long shadow stretching behind him, evening.

scenes.vo: Phir bank ne Amit ko ek message bheja. Aapka rate badh gaya hai, par EMI wahi rahegi. Amit khush ho gaya. Usne socha, wah, bank ne meri jeb pe bojh nahi daala. Mahine ka budget waisa hi rahega. Yahi soch sabse mehngi padti hai.

visual.prompt: A wall calendar with a finish flag pinned on a far page, an invisible hand quietly moving the flag further ahead, the room dim and silent, night.

scenes.vo: Kyunki EMI wahi rakhne ka matlab hai, tenure badh jaana. Rate badha, toh har EMI mein byaaj ka hissa aur bada ho gaya, principal ka hissa aur chhota. Loan khatam hone ki tareekh chupchaap aage khisak gayi. Na koi call, na koi shor.

visual.prompt: BETI in a school uniform doing homework at the dining table, while her father stands behind her holding a loan file, his face turning anxious as he looks at her, evening.

scenes.vo: Socho, Amit ka plan tha ki beti ke college se pehle loan khatam. Ab woh line aage chali gayi. Kuch rate hike aur, aur EMI retirement tak chalti reh sakti hai. Aur har extra saal, matlab poore saal ki EMI, sirf byaaj mein.

visual.prompt: MUMMY in a saree placing cups of chai on a table, frowning with worry, the couple squinting at tiny letters on a phone screen, warm kitchen light.

scenes.vo: Mummy ne chai rakhte hue poocha, bank ne bataya kyun nahi? Bank ne bataya tha, chhote font mein. Zyada log message padhte hain, EMI same dekhte hain, aur aage badh jaate hain. Tenure kitni badhi, yeh koi check hi nahi karta.

visual.prompt: The husband at a bank counter asking BANK UNCLE a pointed question, a fork in a drawn road shown on the wall behind them, one path short and one long, daytime.

scenes.vo: Toh aap kya notice karo? Jab bhi repo rate badhe, apne bank se ek hi sawaal poocho. Meri bachi hui tenure ab kitni hai? Agar tenure badh rahi hai, toh aapke paas do raaste hain. EMI thodi badhao, ya tenure badhne do aur zyada byaaj do.

visual.prompt: WIFE comparing two bank brochures side by side at a desk with a laptop, a sharp sceptical look, afternoon sunlight, no readable text.

scenes.vo: Aur haan, ulta bhi hota hai. Jab repo rate ghatta hai, toh floating rate bhi neeche aana chahiye. Par kai baar purane loan wale tak yeh fayda dheere pahunchta hai. Apna rate bank ke naye rate se compare karte raho. Chup rehna yahan bhi mehnga hai.

scenes.label: Saal mein ek extra EMI

visual.prompt: SG at a chapter turn in the corner of a festive living room with diyas, the couple holding a bonus envelope, the husband eyeing a phone shop leaflet, WIFE raising her hand to stop him, warm evening.

scenes.vo: Ab teesra sawaal, aur yahan kahani palatti hai. Amit ki company ne Diwali pe bonus diya. Pehle plan tha naya phone aur ek trip. Pooja ne kaha, ruko, pehle ek kaam karte hain. Is bonus se loan mein ek extra EMI daal dete hain.

visual.prompt: A drawn arrow of coins flying past a bank-shaped jar and landing straight on a big brick labelled by colour as the loan, chipping a large chunk off it, bright light.

scenes.vo: Isko kehte hain prepayment, yaani tay EMI ke alawa apni marzi se loan ka kuch hissa pehle chuka dena. Aur yahan jo jaadu hai, woh samajhna zaroori hai. Prepayment ka paisa byaaj mein nahi jaata. Woh seedha principal ko katta hai.

visual.prompt: A row of dominoes drawn as months, each one falling and getting smaller, a small house at the end becoming brighter with each domino, daylight.

scenes.vo: Ab yaad karo, byaaj kis pe lagta hai? Bache hue principal pe. Toh jab principal seedha kam hua, agle mahine se byaaj bhi kam laga. Phir har EMI ka zyada hissa principal mein gaya. Yeh ek chain reaction hai jo har saal chalti hai.

visual.prompt: The husband shrugging doubtfully, then leaning in surprised as WIFE shows him a long schedule where the final rows are crossed out far earlier than before, night, lamp light.

scenes.vo: Amit ko laga, ek EMI se kya hoga? Saal bhar toh waise bhi EMI bharte hain, ek aur se kya farak. Logic theek lagta hai. Par schedule ne doosri kahani dikhayi. Har saal ek extra EMI se loan kai saal pehle khatam ho jaata hai.

visual.prompt: A wall calendar with several last pages torn off and floating away as birds, the couple watching from the window with relieved smiles, sunrise.

scenes.vo: Aur jitne saal kam, utne saal ki poori EMI bachi. Woh paisa jo byaaj mein jaana tha, ab aapki jeb mein hai. Kai lakh rupaye ka byaaj, sirf saal mein ek kisht zyada dene se. Na koi nayi scheme, na koi jugaad.

visual.prompt: BANK UNCLE holding up two drawn cards, one showing a shorter road and one showing a smaller coin, WIFE confidently pointing at the shorter road, bank branch, daytime.

scenes.vo: Ek baat dhyan rakho. Prepayment karte waqt bank poochega, EMI kam karni hai ya tenure? Zyada fayda tab hota hai jab EMI wahi rakho aur tenure kam karo. Kyunki byaaj ka asli bill tenure se banta hai. Muddat chhoti, toh bill chhota.

visual.prompt: The husband at home reading the fine print of a loan agreement with a magnifying glass, a highlighter in hand, focused expression, afternoon.

scenes.vo: Floating rate home loan pe aam aadmi ke prepayment pe aam taur pe koi penalty nahi lagti. Phir bhi apne loan ke kagaz ek baar padh lo. Bank se likhit mein lo ki paisa principal mein laga hai. Agle statement mein khud check karo.

visual.prompt: WIFE dropping a small note into a steel piggy bank on a kitchen shelf every month, a row of calendar pages behind her, the piggy bank getting fuller, soft morning light.

scenes.vo: Bonus nahi mila? Koi baat nahi. Har mahine EMI ka thoda sa hissa side mein rakho. Saal ke end tak ek EMI jitna jud jaata hai. Ya jab bhi salary badhe, EMI thodi badha do. Chhote kadam, par 20 saal ke loan pe bahut bade nateeje.

visual.prompt: BETI tugging at her father's sleeve with a curious face, the father kneeling and smiling, pointing at the walls of their flat, warm evening light.

scenes.vo: Beti ne poocha, Papa, hum naya phone kyun nahi le rahe? Amit hasa aur bola, kyunki hum ghar ko jaldi apna bana rahe hain. Pehli baar use laga ki EMI ek bojh nahi, ek plan hai jo uske haath mein hai.

scenes.label: Galti aur kya karein

visual.prompt: SG at a chapter turn watching a young man at a bank desk happily signing papers while staring only at a small coin, ignoring a huge pile of coins under the table, daytime.

scenes.vo: Ab woh galti jo sabse zyada log karte hain. Loan lete waqt sirf EMI dekhna. Bank poochta hai, kitni EMI afford kar sakte ho? Aur hum sabse lambi tenure le lete hain, taaki EMI chhoti dikhe. Kabhi total bill nahi poochte.

visual.prompt: BHAI in a hoodie scrolling a shopping app with new gadgets around him, while a chain attached to his ankle leads to a bank building in the distance, dusk.

scenes.vo: Doosri galti, rate hike ko ignore karna. Teesri, bonus aur salary hike ko lifestyle mein uda dena, aur loan ko apne haal pe chhod dena. Teeno galtiyon ka ek hi nateeja hai. Bank ki kamaai badhti hai, aur aapki aazaadi door hoti jaati hai.

visual.prompt: WIFE at a desk with a checklist notebook, ticking items with a pen, a calm confident face, the husband nodding beside her, morning light, no readable text.

scenes.vo: Toh kya karein? Pehla, loan lete waqt bank se poora amortisation schedule maango, aur total byaaj ki line zaroor padho. Doosra, har rate change pe bachi hui tenure check karo. Teesra, saal mein kam se kam ek extra EMI ka plan banao.

visual.prompt: BEHEN in office wear at a laptop with tax papers spread out, raising a sceptical eyebrow at a long loan file, office desk, afternoon.

scenes.vo: Aur tax ka ek point. Old regime mein home loan ka principal us deduction mein aata hai jiski limit 1,50,000 rupaye hai. Par isi limit mein PPF, EPF jaisi cheezein bhi aati hain. New regime mein yeh nahi milta. Toh tax ke chakkar mein loan lamba mat kheencho.

visual.prompt: The whole family on the balcony of their flat at sunset, PAPA, MUMMY, WIFE, her husband and BETI, sharing chai, peaceful faces, city lights coming on.

scenes.vo: Yaad rakho, ghar lena galat nahi hai. Ghar sukoon deta hai, aur kiraye se aazaadi bhi. Bas loan ko andhere mein mat chalao. Jo cheez aap 20 saal tak bharoge, use ek shaam baith ke samajhna toh banta hai. Yeh investment advice nahi hai.

visual.prompt: SG in a striped shirt sitting on a stool facing the viewer, holding a phone with a banking app open, an inviting questioning smile, soft studio-like daylight, no readable text.

scenes.vo: Ab aapse ek seedha sawaal. Aapke ghar mein home loan chal raha hai, toh kya aapko pata hai ki uski bachi hui tenure abhi kitni hai? Haan ya nahi, comment mein likho. Aur agar nahi pata, toh kal hi bank app khol ke dekho.

visual.prompt: A drawn crossroads with a house with keys on one side and a rented flat with a growing plant on the other, SG standing in the middle scratching his chin, golden evening light.

scenes.vo: Agle video mein ek aur bada sawaal. Ghar khareedna behtar hai, ya kiraye pe reh kar paisa invest karna? Hisaab wahi seedhi baat wala hoga. Tab tak yeh video us dost ko bhejo jo naya ghar lene ki soch raha hai.

thumbnail.scene: WIFE stares at a long printed loan statement in her hands under a lamp at night, eyes wide, mouth open.

topic.summary: A family buys a flat on a 20-year home loan; the amortisation schedule shows interest front-loaded, the total paid roughly double the price, and what prepaying one extra EMI a year does. Explain EMI, principal, interest, prepayment, floating rate.
topic.title: 50 lakh ka ghar, 1 crore ka bill: 20 saal ki EMI mein bank kitna kamata hai
